Github user Leemoonsoo commented on the pull request:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/commit/8790ba97caf0a08f7d73a3dec6b583f572f18189#commitcomment-18231592

I think this change is somehow related to https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/ZEPPELIN-1169. @jongyoul, could you take a look https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/ZEPPELIN-1169?

I've tested it but I cannot reproduce it.

mvn clean package -DskipTests
echo "1,2,3,4" > /tmp/test.csv

Github user jongyoul commented on the pull request:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/commit/8790ba97caf0a08f7d73a3dec6b583f572f18189#commitcomment-18247303

I've updated comments into ZEPPELIN-1169

I have cloned and build Zeppelin from master branch with

mvn clean package -Pspark-1.6 -Phadoop-2.4 -Pyarn -Ppyspark -DskipTests

And start without any other configuration. And i can still reproduce the problem.
jongyoul Could you verify with above build command again?
moon I've got the same error and it looks related hadoop-client. I'll make a hotfix and merge it asap. I'll also find a way to run a selenium in Safari.
I've found the exact guava version of hadoop-common which is 11.0.2, but I'll revert the past value.
